svg.title: Only the line that creates the Store changes
svg.desc: Two stacks with the same top. The code that reads and writes the books goes through the same Repository, new LibraryRepository(store). Below it, two Stores: NewInMemoryRepositoryStore, whose data disappears when the process stops, and NewFileRepositoryStore, whose data is there again when the Store opens again, in this process or in another one.
svg.text: Only the line that creates the Store changes
The Repository binds your model to a Store; every line that reads or writes the books stays the same
Every line that reads or writes the books
